options.content: Peering Traffic In and Out of SCinet
NRE Traffic on SCinet

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(observation_time) AS time,
  sum(in_bits_delta) / $__interval_s as Rate
FROM
  data_interface_traffic_view (
    ids = ['scn-sw-arst-1', 'scn-sw-arst-2', 'scn-sw-cela-3'],
    from = $__fromTime,
    to = $__toTime
  )
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(observation_time)
  AND observation_time != '2026-11-16 20:48:00'
  AND observation_time != '2026-11-16 20:30:00'
  AND interface_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM
      meta_interface
    WHERE
      flow_index IS NOT NULL
      AND description LIKE '%5438%'
    GROUP BY
      id
    ORDER BY
      id
  )
GROUP BY
  time
ORDER BY
  time ASC

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(observation_time) AS time,
  interface_id,
  sum(in_bits_delta) / $__interval_s as Rate
FROM
  data_interface_traffic_view (
    ids = ['scn-sw-cena-4'],
    from
      = $__fromTime,
      to = $__toTime
  )
WHERE
  interface_id IN [
    'scn-sw-cena-4::1'
  ]
  AND $__timeFilter(observation_time)
GROUP BY
  interface_id,
  time
ORDER BY
  time ASC
